name: Why should I hire a general contractor instead of managing trades myself?

mainEntity.name: Why should I hire a general contractor instead of managing trades myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor serves as a single point of contact who oversees the entire project schedule, workflow, and quality control. In a kitchen remodel, various trades must work in precise sequence: demolition, framing, rough-in plumbing, electrical, drywall, tile setting, finish carpentry, and painting. Hiring individual trades independently puts the burden of scheduling, troubleshooting conflicts, and coordinating handoffs on the homeowner. A hands-on contractor like Abraham Becerra manages these phases on-site, directly handling finish carpentry, drywall, and tile while coordinating specialized mechanical trades so tasks do not overlap or stall project momentum.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor manages the sequencing of trades, handles on-site problem-solving, and oversees finish work, saving homeowners the stress of managing schedules.
